"Heat Exchanger"
m__dot_1=1'kg/s ; m__dot_2=2'kg/s ; ϑ_1E=25'degC  ; ϑ_2E=110'degC  ; ϑ_2A=90'degC
k=2500'W/(m^2*K) ; c_{p,1} = 4180'kJ/(kg*K) ; c_{p,2} = 4215'kJ/(kg*K) 
picture("sketchHex", width=300, align=left)
Q__dot=m__dot_2*c_{p,2}*(ϑ_2E-ϑ_2A) |kW
ϑ_1A=solve(Eq(Q__dot,m__dot_1*c_{p,1}*(ϑ_1A-ϑ_1E)),ϑ_1A) |degC

Δϑ_1=ϑ_2E-ϑ_1E ;"          "; Δϑ_2=ϑ_2A-ϑ_1A
'-> '; Δϑ_max=Δϑ_1 ;' und '; Δϑ_min=Δϑ_2
Δϑ_m=(Δϑ_max-Δϑ_min)/ln(Δϑ_max/Δϑ_min)
'Hex area:  ';  A=Q__dot/(k*Δϑ_m)
